canonical_statement: For every abelian category C, (A) C has a full, faithful functor to modules over a ring preserving finite limits and finite colimits; (B) if C is complete with enough injectives, every separator yields an injective coseparator; and (C) dually, if C is cocomplete with enough projectives, every coseparator yields a projective separator.
domain_and_universes: universe v u; C : Type u; Category.{v} C; Abelian C; embedding ring R : Type (max u v); ModuleCat.{max u v} R
quantifiers: embedding: exists R, Ring R, and F
injective: forall implicit HasLimits and EnoughInjectives, forall separator G
projective: forall implicit HasColimits and EnoughProjectives, forall coseparator G
conclusion: EmbeddingBranch C and InjectiveBranch C and ProjectiveBranch C

alternate_encodings.target: the fully unfolded conjunction in canonicalStatement_iff_unfolded

excluded_degenerate_cases: none; no Nonempty or nontriviality premise is present

mutation_tests.mutation: remove EnoughInjectives from the injective branch
choose one ring before quantifying C
